title: Building AI infrastructure with the Effingham County community
summary: OpenAI在乔治亚州埃芬厄姆县启动Project Camellia，承诺负责任能源、社区投资、就业机会及Codex访问，但未涉及具体技术要点如模型、架构或基准。

extra.description: OpenAI announces Project Camellia in Effingham County, Georgia, with commitments to responsible energy, community investment, jobs, and access to Codex.
